# Tech Handlers

> Delhi NCR–based digital marketing and web development agency offering SEO, performance marketing, social media, lead generation, and custom web development.

Tech Handlers helps businesses in Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, and beyond grow online through data-driven digital marketing and high-performance website development.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Agency overview, services, case studies, and contact.
- [About](/about): Team, values, and approach.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on digital marketing, SEO, and web development.

## Services

- [Digital Marketing](/services/digital-marketing): SEO, social media, content, email automation.
- [Performance Marketing](/services/performance-marketing): Paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn.
- [SEO](/services/seo): On-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO.
- [Social Media Marketing](/services/social-media-marketing): Strategy, content, and community management.
- [Web Development](/services/web-development): Custom websites, e-commerce, web apps.
- [LinkedIn Automation](/services/linkedin-automation): B2B outreach and lead generation.
